useWhen: Reporting a discrete result without blocking the task, such as a saved change or a finished export
avoidWhen: Showing work still in progress, or a failure the user must act on; keep it beside its source

obligations: Expose an alertdialog toast with an alert content announcement.
Provide a dismiss action and visible variant distinction.

behavior: ToastProvider renders the notification region and owns the queue.
Toast and useToast throw outside a ToastProvider.
useToast returns the nearest provider's stable manager.
The manager's add(message, options) enqueues a toast and returns its key.
The manager's remove(key) closes the toast with that key.
The add options are title, variant, duration, onDismiss, and className.
variant is neutral, success, warning, or danger, and defaults to neutral. It changes how the toast looks, not how long it stays.
ToastProvider takes maxVisible (default 5), placement (default top-end), and className.
maxVisible is read when the provider first mounts, so a later change has no effect.
maxVisible must be finite and at least 1 once rounded down, or ToastProvider throws a TypeError.
When more toasts are queued than fit, the newest stay visible and older ones wait in the queue.
placement is top-start, top-end, bottom-start, or bottom-end, and an unsupported value throws a TypeError.
Duration is in milliseconds.
A duration of 0 sets no expiry timer, so that toast stays until the user dismisses it or remove closes it.
A negative or non-finite duration, or one above 2147483647 ms (about 24.8 days), throws a TypeError, and no toast is added.
Timers pause while the pointer is over the toast region or focus is inside it, and resume when neither applies.
Toast declaratively enqueues one notification when it mounts.
A later render that changes its message, title, variant, className, or onDismiss updates the visible toast in place.
An in-place update adds no toast, does not reset the timer, and does not call onDismiss.
Changing duration replaces the notification with a new one.
A timeout or an explicit dismissal, including remove, calls onDismiss at most once.
A dismissed toast keeps its exit animation.
Declarative unmount, replacement, and provider teardown remove the notification without calling onDismiss.
accessibility: Each toast has role alertdialog with its title and description linked, and its content has role alert.
Keep dismiss controls keyboard accessible and the toast region outside overlay hiding.

When a focused toast is dismissed, keyboard focus moves to the next remaining toast, else the previous one; pointer dismissals and the last toast return focus to the element focused before the region.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
